dateFrom.description: Include only open houses on or after this date (e.g. '2026-05-01'). Leave blank for no lower bound.
dateFrom.title: Date From (YYYY-MM-DD)

dateTo.description: Include only open houses on or before this date (e.g. '2026-05-31'). Leave blank for no upper bound.
dateTo.title: Date To (YYYY-MM-DD)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of open house listings to return (1–500).
maxItems.title: Max Items

scrapeDetails.description: Also visit each property's own Zillow page for lot size, stories, HOA fee, price per square foot, listing agent/broker name and phone, description and photos. Slower; turn off for a quick listing.
scrapeDetails.title: Scrape listing detail pages

search.description: Free-text location to search for open houses: city name, ZIP code, neighborhood, or address (e.g. 'Austin, TX', '90210', 'Brooklyn, NY').
search.title: Location Search

startUrls.description: Zillow search or open-house URLs to scrape. The open house filter is injected automatically if not present.
startUrls.title: Start URLs
